en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a residential neighborhood with large detached villas, gardens, and tree‑lined streets. The houses have early 20th‑century European architecture, some with turrets and ornate facades. In the distance are open fields and low hills. Printed in red at the top are the words "Grossröhrsdorf i. Sa." on the left and "König Albert- u. Lutherstrasse." on the right.
